Real row 4 v8 = S3 + S4, stage B only, resumed from real_row4v7/checkpoint_a.pt (A is unchanged by S4: no memory in A) with the layer prior's P37 table added (fitted from A's own store by the same function S4's session end runs; real_row4v8/checkpoint_a.pt, session_a linked to real_row4v7's). Flags: --backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g8-holdout --session-keyframes --online-step5 --resume --sessions ab. Evaluated with eval_row.sh SES='a b'; compared with rows 1/3 and v7; G1 F1 decides; predictions are readings only.

S4 = the fork's step-5 vote (session_refusion.cpp:1150-1206 evidence, 1269-1294 decision: seen through = through > hit; hidden = hit = 0, through = 0, 2 band > blocked) on the earlier sessions' memory (R15 test set: background + current objects whose state began before the session, session_refusion.cpp:1071-1081), applied online: each round adds that round's frames to per-element running counts and decides on the totals; an end is final; the last round's decision on the same memory equals the fork's session-end decision. h / T = the fork's element bands (1068-1069, 1087-1088), tau = max(h, sigma(q)). No session-end pass. Eq. 5 self-check: an element ended at round t leaves the map of t and later; earlier maps keep it.

sigma(q): the P37 depth-noise table (session_refusion.cpp:940-1007) fitted on a session's own present surface at its end and carried to the next session as a layer step (S4 makes it inherent; it is a sensor calibration, not a map edit). For this rerun A's table is fitted from A's store by that same function: 2.38 2.14 1.78 1.60 1.84 1.94 2.09 2.20 2.65 2.31 2.85 ... cm per 0.5 m range bin. No new constant.
